sentence: And the retail evidence turns the channel configurational: performance comes from combinations of AI applications rather than single uses, and out of the combinations grow new capabilities, adaptive learning among them
passage: [Cao et al. (2025), p. 1] "superior performance stems not from isolated AI uses but from synergistic combinations--particularly those involving customer service and cybersecurity--interacting with other functions. These configurations appear to give rise to emergent capabilities such as adaptive learning, predictive analytics, and uncertainty mitigation"

gemini.overclaim: retail evidence turns the channel configurational
gemini.note: The passage supports the claim that performance comes from synergistic AI combinations that give rise to emergent capabilities like adaptive learning, but it does not mention retail evidence or the channel.
